title: Foo Fighters drawn to WWII atomic and military programs

tellings.quote: military operations right we know that U are interested in nuclear capabilities and our military capabilities so um what was going on at the height of World War II

plain: The foo fighters, strange glowing lights that Allied airmen reported over southern Germany in 1944 and 1945, may have been drawn there by the war's atomic and military work, according to a former Pentagon intelligence official named Luis Elizondo. He offers this as his own reasoning, without naming a source: since unexplained craft seem "interested in nuclear capabilities and our military capabilities," he asks what was going on at the height of the war. If true, it would mean the interest in weapons sites goes back before the nuclear age began in earnest.
